about: I am a second-year Computer Engineering student at Indira College of Engineering and Management, affiliated with Savitribai Phule Pune University. My current focus includes full-stack development, applied artificial intelligence, computer vision, automation, and geospatial technology. I enjoy converting complex ideas into structured and practical products with strong interfaces, reliable workflows, and clear documentation. Alongside project development, I am strengthening my problem-solving skills through Data Structures and Algorithms using Striver’s roadmap.

currentProjects.solution: An intelligent study platform for content organization, summaries, quizzes, flashcards, question answering, and personalized revision plans.

currentProjects.name: ResumeAI
currentProjects.problem: Students and early professionals need structured feedback to improve resumes and identify critical skill gaps.
currentProjects.solution: An AI-powered resume analysis and career optimization platform for stronger resume quality and targeted preparation.

currentProjects.name: Generative AI Cloud Removal for Satellite Imagery
currentProjects.problem: Cloud obstruction limits reliable visual interpretation in earth observation workflows.
currentProjects.solution: A multimodal reconstruction approach using optical imagery, SAR data, elevation data, and temporal references.
